failureMessage: the vendor set ships a pack only when declared, so a cross-pack import crashes every consumer that vendors one pack without the other
fix: declare the dependency (requires) and pass configuration, move the shared helper into engine/checks/helpers, or accept the import with a reason under checks.accept in .claudinite/settings.yaml

forbidReferences.reason: a pack imports only its own files, and the engine surface — abilities otherwise cross pack boundaries through declaration and configuration, never imports

failureMessage: the directory name is the public id every member declares, so another casing costs a fleet-wide rename

forbidTrackedPathsMatching.what: a pack directory that is not kebab-case: {path}
forbidTrackedPathsMatching.fix: rename the directory to lowercase kebab-case before anyone declares it

failureMessage: a quoted count of checks or rules is stale at the next change; name what to count instead

matchLines.fix: say how to count them instead of quoting the number

failureMessage: .claudinite/local/packs/<pack>/ exists only in the canon home, so the name dangles everywhere else the prose mounts

matchLines.what: names a home-only local pack path: {match}
matchLines.fix: point at the canon pack that owns the artifact, or describe it without its home path

failureMessage: the pack and engine lanes deliver on separate cadences, so a named import of an export the member's engine lacks is a link-time SyntaxError faulting the whole pack

checkSetValues.what: a pack imports the engine export {value} by name in the change that adds it
checkSetValues.fix: import the engine module as a namespace and guard the call with a typeof capability check
